talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.0: Look! Look up! The sky's on fire!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.1: A falling rock... it's coming down this way!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.0: A shooting star! No, it's too big... it's falling!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.1: See it? A star, coming down to earth!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.2: Make a wish... and then run.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.0: Did you feel that? Something came down out there!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.1: It struck the ground! The whole earth shook!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.2: Stay back from where it hit, I beg you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.2: Whoa... when I grow up I'm doing that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.0: Did... did you all see that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.1: That's no trick of the light. That's sorcery.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.2: I'm not drinking at the tavern tonight. I've seen enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.0: They called the wind like a dog to heel!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.1: The air itself is doing what they say!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.2: Hold onto your hats... and your roofs.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.0: Ropes! Out of their wrists! Like a spider!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.1: They swing from the rooftops like it's nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.2: I'll be finding cobwebs on my washing for a week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.1: Things fall UP around that one. I saw it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.2: Don't stand near them, the ground goes heavy.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.1: I blinked and they were somewhere else entirely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.2: There were two of them for a moment. Two!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.0: Blades out of thin air! Out of nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.1: Where are all those weapons coming from?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.2: They've an armoury hidden in the very sky.
Did you hear that hum? My teeth are still ringing.
The air shivers around them like a struck bell.
That sound... it went right through my chest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.0: The shadows moved when they moved.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.1: It went dark around them, in broad day!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.2: Something in the dark answers to that one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.1: That band on their wrist just glowed green... no, it glowed wrong.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.2: They were a person a moment ago. Weren't they?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.1: That thing has teeth everywhere! Get inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.2: Guards! There's a living tar loose in the streets!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.0: A shadow walking on its own! Gods save us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.1: That's no man, that's a shade! Don't look at it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.2: The dark's come for us! Inside, all of you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.0: A monster! A monster in the village!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.1: What in the world is THAT?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.2: Hide the children, something's come out of the sky!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.0: %s isn't themselves! Look at their eyes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.2: That's not %s any more. That black stuff has them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.0: The moon's bleeding. Bar the doors tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.1: Red moon. The dead don't stay down under a red moon.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.2: My grandmother said a moon like that means graves open.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.super_blood: Never seen it so red. Never. Pray.
The whole sky's the colour of a wound...
Get inside. Whatever comes up tonight, it's hungry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.0: Harvest moon! The fields'll be heavy come morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.1: Look how big and golden it is. A good omen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.2: Fine night for it. The crops love a moon like this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.0: A blue moon... they say anything can happen under one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.1: Strange light tonight. Strange things about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.2: The moon's gone cold and blue. I don't like it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.3: It's getting bigger! Why is it getting bigger?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.4: Fire in the sky! Somebody ring the bell!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.5: That's no bird. Get the little ones indoors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.3: It's green! Stars aren't meant to be green!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.4: It's leaving a trail like spilt milk across the sky.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.5: My grandfather saw one of those. He was never right after.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.3: Smoke over the trees! That's where it came down!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.4: My pots all fell off the shelf. What WAS that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.5: Don't anybody go poking at it. I mean it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.3: I'm telling everyone! Nobody will believe me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.4: Can you teach me? Please? PLEASE?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.5: That was the best thing I've ever seen!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.3: Mother of mercy. Did they mean to do that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.4: I've heard of hedge-witches, but that's something else.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.5: Somebody fetch the priest. Or the wizard. Both.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.3: The weathervane's spinning like a top!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.4: They stepped off the roof and just... didn't fall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.5: A gale out of a clear sky. That's not natural.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.3: They stuck to the wall like a fly!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.4: Up the tower in three swings. Three!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.5: Mind your head, there's rope everywhere.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.3: My bucket just went up. UP.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.4: The ground cracked under them like an egg.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.5: I felt heavy for a moment, like the sky was sitting on me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.3: Everything slowed down, like wading through honey.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.4: The rain stopped in the air. Stopped!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.5: I think I just lived the same moment twice.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.3: A rain of swords! Stand clear!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.4: Was that a cannon? Out of the sky?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.5: Every one of those blades just vanished again.
The bells in the chapel started ringing on their own.
My cup cracked. Just from the noise.
It's like the whole street is humming along with them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.3: The lamp went out when they walked by.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.4: Their shadow didn't move with them. It moved first.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.5: It's gone cold. Feel that? It's gone cold.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.3: There's a flash of green and then... that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.4: How many shapes does one person need?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.5: I'd swear it was a person a breath ago.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.3: It's crawling! The tar is crawling!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.4: Don't let it touch you! It gets inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.5: All those teeth... all those teeth!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.3: Its eyes are burning in the dark!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.4: Light a torch! Light every torch!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.5: That shadow's got nobody under it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.4: Bar the doors! Bar the doors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.5: Is it a demon? It's a demon!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.3: Don't let %s near you, something's wearing them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.5: Get away from %s! Look at the black in their mouth!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.3: Hear the dogs howling? They know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.4: Keep your shovel by the bed tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.5: The graveyard's restless. I can feel it from here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.super_blood: I've never seen a moon swallow the sky like that.
The old stories said a moon like this ends kingdoms.
Every dead thing for miles will be walking tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.3: Leave a sheaf out for the moon, my mother always said.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.4: You could read a letter by that light.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.5: Fat gold moon. Fat full larders.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.3: I found a coin on the path just now. Lucky night.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.4: Blue light on the water... strange and lovely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.5: Feels like anything could happen. Good or bad.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.0: Oh, it's just them again. Still gives me the creeps.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.1: We know it's you in there. Wipe your feet, at least.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.2: Changed again? Mind the chickens this time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.3: They've done it again. Everyone stay calm, it's only them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.4: I'll never get used to that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.5: Here, the children want to see. Go on, show them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.0: There goes the black suit again. Keep it away from my dog.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.1: I know it's you under there, but you're still dripping.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.2: Does it ever get hungry? Don't answer that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.3: They've done it again. Everyone stay calm, it's only them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.4: I'll never get used to that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.5: Here, the children want to see. Go on, show them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.0: Our shadow-walker's out again. Evening, I suppose.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.1: I know it's you. I still don't like looking at you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.2: Mind the lanterns, you make them gutter.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.3: They've done it again. Everyone stay calm, it's only them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.4: I'll never get used to that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.5: Here, the children want to see. Go on, show them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.6: The heavens are throwing stones at us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.7: It's heading for the hills! No, it's heading for US!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.8: Somebody's angered the sky, and I bet it was you lot.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.9: Look at the tail on it! Like a burning comet!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.11: I knew I should have stayed in bed today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.6: It's so bright I can see my own shadow at night!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.7: Is that what the old songs mean by a fallen star?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.8: It's singing. Can you hear it? It's singing as it falls.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.9: Quick, someone mark where it lands!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.10: Bet that's worth a fortune, whatever it is.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.11: My mother said a falling star means someone's coming. Something, maybe.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.6: The birds have all gone quiet.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.7: I'll not go near that hole for all the gold in the realm.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.8: Hear that hissing? It's still hot.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.9: The ground's still trembling under my feet.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.10: Somebody should tell the lord. Or the priest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.11: My chickens won't lay for a week after that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.6: Can I touch it? Can I? Just once?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.7: My big brother said that was impossible. Ha!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.8: I want to be just like you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.9: That was SO loud! Do it louder!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.10: I'm going to draw it on the wall. Mama will be cross.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.11: Are you a hero? You look like a hero.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.6: That's the sort of thing they burn folk for, in the old tales.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.7: Nobody tell my wife I saw that. She'll want one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.9: I'm sure there's a perfectly sensible reason. I just can't think of one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.10: My knees have gone to water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.11: Is it catching? Tell me it's not catching.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.6: Look at the dust devils dancing round them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.7: My laundry's in the next village now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.8: They breathe out and the trees bow.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.9: They're standing in midair like it's a floor!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.10: I felt the wind change. It wanted to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.11: If that one sneezes, we lose the roof.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.6: Did they just pull that cart with a string?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.7: Like a spider and a bird had a child.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.8: They're upside down on the bell tower! Again!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.9: Sticky stuff on my doorstep, and I know whose it is.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.10: That rope snapped tight like a bowstring.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.11: They caught the thief with a web! Mid-run!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.6: The cobbles came up out of the road!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.7: Hold onto something, the ground's pulling!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.8: They lifted the whole cart and the horse with it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.9: Everything round them just sort of sank.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.10: They threw that boulder like a pebble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.11: My ears popped. Why did my ears pop?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.6: My candle burned down in a blink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.7: They walked away and left themselves standing there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.8: The bird stopped in the air. Mid-flap!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.9: I swear I've heard this conversation before.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.10: The church bell rang twice, but only once.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.11: They moved like everyone else was stuck in mud.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.6: A spear just came out of the air beside my head!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.7: They've got more steel than the king's armoury.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.8: Blades orbiting them like moons round a world.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.9: Shields, swords, cannons, out of nothing. Nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.10: One flick of the wrist and a hundred swords fall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.11: Where do they put it all? Where?
The glass in my window just sang.
I can feel it in my teeth.
The water in the trough is rippling and nobody's touched it.
It's like standing inside a struck bell.
The dogs are howling at them.
Every pot on my shelf rattled.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.6: The torches just bent away from them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.7: Something moved in their shadow. Something with arms.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.8: I can't see their face. Just dark.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.9: The cold followed them in like a dog.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.1: Even the cat won't look at them.
That's the kind of dark that looks back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.6: A fire walking about like a man!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.7: There's a giant of stone in the square!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.9: They pressed the band and became that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.1: Was that a golem? Or them? Or both?
I counted the arms. There are too many arms.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.7: Something under that black is screaming!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.8: Shut the shutters, it's at the windows!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.9: It moved like a hundred snakes at once!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.10: Fire! Black things hate fire, get the torches!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.11: It looked right at me! With what? It has no eyes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.6: The dead have come back as shadows!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.7: It walks but its feet make no sound!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.8: The torches are going out where it passes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.9: It's a ghost! A ghost in the streets!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.10: Don't let it touch your shadow!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.11: Ring the bell! The night's walking!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.0: %s? We buried you. I held the shovel.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.1: Why is %s so cold? It's high summer.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.3: I could swear %s died. Didn't they die?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.4: %s's shadow doesn't move when they do. Look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.5: Something's wrong with %s. The dogs won't go near them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.6: %s used to laugh at everything. Now they just stare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.7: Did you see %s's eyes? There's nothing behind them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.8: %s walked right through the hearth smoke and it didn't even stir.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.9: I said good morning to %s and they answered in my mother's voice.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.10: %s smells of wet earth. Every day, wet earth.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.11: %s doesn't breathe when they sleep. I checked.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.0: %s is DEAD! I saw them dead! Run!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.1: Get away from %s! That's not them, it's wearing them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.2: The grave's let go of %s! Gods help us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.3: %s came back wrong! Bar the doors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.5: I watched %s die and there they stand! Away, away!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.6: It's %s's face but something else is looking out! Run!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.7: %s has no shadow but the one inside! Flee!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.8: The dead walk among us! %s, the dead!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.9: Fetch the priest! %s has come back from the ground!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.risen.11: Run! %s's been walking about dead all week!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.2: Mama says %s went to sleep forever. But there they are.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.3: %s doesn't have a heartbeat. I put my ear on them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.5: Is %s a ghost? Can I be a ghost too?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.6: %s didn't eat their bread. They never eat their bread now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.7: %s stood in the rain and didn't get wet.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.8: I don't like how %s smiles now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.9: %s told me the ground is quiet. What does that mean?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.10: Why are the chickens scared of %s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.child.11: %s knows my name but says it funny.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.1: I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.2: Was I away? It feels like I was away.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.3: The sun is so loud today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.4: I can't remember the taste of bread.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.5: Why is it so quiet inside me?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.6: Somebody's walking where I should be.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.7: I keep dreaming of dark water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.9: Back to work. Back to work. Back to work.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.10: Something called me, and I came.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.risen.self.11: I'm sure I had a heartbeat yesterday.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.6: Get the guards! No, get ALL the guards!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.7: It's not from here! It's not from anywhere!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.8: Don't look in its eyes! Any of them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.9: It came out of a falling star, I saw it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.11: What does it want? WHAT DOES IT WANT?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.0: A tail! It's got a TAIL! Werewolf!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.1: That's no traveller, look behind them! Run!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.2: Beast! A beast in a man's clothes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.3: Lock the doors, there's a tailed thing in the street!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.4: It's one of those wolf-folk! Get the children in!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.5: Gods, that tail's moving on its own!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.7: I knew it, I KNEW something was wrong with that one!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.8: Is it a werewolf? Is it worse? I'm not staying to find out!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.9: Don't let it near you, the tail's how they get you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.11: Mother warned me about tailed folk. RUN!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.7: Look at %s's eyes! They've gone black!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.8: That's not %s talking, it's the black stuff!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.10: Somebody help %s! No, don't go near!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.6: The crows are all roosting early. They know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.7: Red sky at night, nobody's delight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.8: I'll be sleeping with my boots on tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.9: Smells like iron out here. Like blood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.10: Don't go past the graveyard. Not tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.11: The old ones are stirring under the hill.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.super_blood: It looks close enough to touch. Don't.
Even the guards are scared, and they're never scared.
This is the night the stories warned about.
The well water's gone red. I'm not imagining it.
Hold your loved ones close. Hold them tight.
Every dog in the realm is howling.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.6: Pumpkins'll be the size of carts by morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.7: Good night for a dance in the barn.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.8: My old knees feel younger under that moon.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.9: Look at the fields shine gold!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.10: The bees are still out. In the dark! Busy little things.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.11: They say a child born under the harvest moon never goes hungry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.7: I won three games of dice tonight. Three!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.9: Even the creepers look a bit friendly tonight. A bit.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.10: The water's gone blue as a sapphire.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.11: Something lucky's going to happen. I can feel it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.6: Oh, it's you. Don't step on the flowerbeds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.7: Morning! Or... whatever you are this morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.8: Same person, new face. We're used to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.9: Could you be the big stone one? The kids love that one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.10: Just let us know before you turn into something with fangs.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.11: Thank you for not eating anyone. Again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.6: Hello again. And hello to your... friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.7: Keep it on a leash, please. My goats.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.8: I suppose it keeps you warm, at least.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.9: Tell it the butcher's got scraps if it's hungry. Not us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.1: You look like a walking puddle of ink. A friendly one.
We know, we know. It's just you. Still shiver, though.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.6: Evening, shadow. Keep to the dark bits, you'll scare the cattle.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.7: It's only them. Their shadow, anyway.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.8: Back from the dead again? You're making a habit of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.9: Do shadows eat? I've got soup if you want it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.10: Come by in daylight next time. We miss your face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.11: Our very own ghost. Lucky us.
They've got more steel than the queen's armoury.
